title: Townspeople climb the 1835 cottages' front steps
items: In 1835 a townsperson going in at a cottage door now walks up its front steps to the landing, where before they walked through the steps at ground level. All 164 house stoops are steps now, the 15 under a small porch roof among them, and you can climb them too.
The steps were always centred on their doors. Only the walk to the door was wrong.
